title: Is Your Emergency Kit Ready? Essential Tips for Every Home
description:
Disasters can strike Los Angeles—or any community—at a moment’s notice, from sudden earthquakes to severe weather. That’s why City leaders are urging all Angelenos to take action during National Preparedness Month this September.

Because Los Angeles covers such a vast area, first responders may not be able to reach every neighborhood immediately during a crisis. In those critical early hours, neighbors often serve as one another’s first lifeline. Staying connected and helping those nearby can make entire communities safer.

Preparing today helps ensure your household is ready for whatever comes tomorrow. Residents and business owners should review their emergency plans, practice evacuation routes, and check disaster kits for essential supplies.

Small steps now can make a significant difference later. Visit https://ready.lacity.gov/ for disaster preparedness guides, emergency checklists, and community resources to help protect you and your loved ones.
